doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Touring with the Mighty Wiggle Carnival at fifteen
summary: Billie and sister Edna left home at about fifteen with a carnival owned by Jack Schaefer, playing pipe organ in a show while Edna danced, travelling through Florida and the South.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah, Catholic, that's what I thought. Could you tell us some more about that show, you say you went and played with shows and all that?

Well, my sister Edna and I went out on the show business. And when we left home, I was about 15 years of age. And the first show we went on was what's called Mighty Wiggle, Mighty Wiggle Carnival. And it was owned by Jack Schaefer.
Where did they travel? Florida or?
Yeah, they traveled all over Florida and all in the South, Alabama, Georgia, Florida, Tennessee, all up the lines. But I didn't go up the line with them. Yes, I see.

All down, Miami, Cedar Keys, Micah Nopi, Kendry, Orlando, O'Kellar, Wildwood, Tallahassee, Jacksonville, Daytona, Lakeland. Was that more like a carnival show? It was a carnival, it was a carnival, yeah. What did you play for? I was playing a pipe organ in the color ministry show. That's what I was playing. And Edna, she danced stage. Did you do any singing with it too? Yeah, I used to get up there, I used to, I used to, I used to, I used to, I used to double. Yeah.
Sing, dance too. When I get tired of playing, Edna, she was sitting, playing with the band. Like that, see.
Your sister was in the same show.
Yeah, she and I was in the, she and I was together.
